output.title: Furnished renovated studio with historic character in Clausen
output.description:
This studio apartment occupies a thoughtfully renovated space within a historic stone building on a narrow street in Clausen. Measuring 38 m², the interior combines rustic elements, such as exposed beams and wood flooring, with modern updates and efficient use of space.

The main living area integrates a double bed and a kitchenette placed conveniently in one corner. The compact kitchenette is equipped with a two-burner cooktop, a small refrigerator, a stainless steel sink, and cabinetry, offering functional amenities while maintaining a streamlined footprint.

Adjacent to the living space is the bathroom, recently renovated with white tile, a compact vanity, and a shower stall, presenting a clean and contemporary atmosphere. The building's setting in Clausen contributes historical character and an atmospheric environment distinct to this area.

The studio is offered fully furnished, providing a ready-to-use residence within this preserved part of the city. Its characterful interior design and practical layout are suited to those seeking a compact urban dwelling that respects the architectural heritage of its building.

While specific nearby amenities or transit options are not detailed in the available data, the Clausen valley setting offers a unique context within an established and historic district of the city.

Compact and functional kitchenette with cooktop
Recent bathroom renovation with modern fittings
Located in a historic stone building with maintained facade
Efficient use of 38 m² living space
